svg.text: 50 mm: print at 100% / actual size, then measure this bar
Seen from the switch side. Tape the film over this sheet and cut on the black lines:
grey = film (keep), white = cut out, red + = screw hole centre.
Film = where the top-shell STL touches the PCB, 0.3 mm smaller all round. Use 0.10-0.13 mm (4-5 mil) PET film.
